items.title: Project operating system and evidence validator
items.objective: Create enforceable, machine-checked strategy, task, decision, evidence and release records.
items.user_problem: The project repeatedly produces activity without an auditable user outcome or stop decision.
deliverables: Machine-readable work register, decision policy, evidence ledger and release gates
Validator, tests and read-only GitHub workflow
acceptance_criteria: All governance JSON records pass the validator
Invalid status, missing evidence, unknown dependency and dependency cycle are rejected by tests
GitHub workflow runs on the exact branch head and is read-only
stop_conditions: Do not enable code-authoring agent or paid services
Do not weaken existing branch or runner boundaries

items.title: Truthful research-only product shell and safe outputs
items.objective: Remove unvalidated decision outputs and fake chatbot claims from the user experience.
items.user_problem: The user could be shown invented market metrics, confidence and allocation claims as though they were live analysis.
deliverables: Truthful product guide instead of fabricated AI answers
acceptance_criteria: Exact PR head CI passes
No default-capital decision call or automatic scoring/backtest fetch remains in the user flow
Chat helper never invents live values or claims to be an LLM
After integration, browser/API smoke confirms blocked outputs return unavailable and no fabricated metrics appear
stop_conditions: Keep scoring, ranking, probability and backtest approval disabled
Do not enable gate via deployment environment

items.title: Market coverage and canonical instrument registry
items.objective: Make source coverage and data readiness visible without treating candidate feeds as accepted.
items.user_problem: The user cannot tell which markets have usable data, which sources are candidates, and why analysis is unavailable.
deliverables: Provider-neutral registry and temporal price-basis controls
acceptance_criteria: Exact PR head CI and container smoke pass
Iranian universes remain quarantined until full acceptance
Unknown instruments cannot be persisted
After integration, a browser/API scenario shows source status, data quality and instrument availability without fabricated values
stop_conditions: No unapproved source in scoring, labels or investment reports
No raw/private dataset or price values in CI logs

items.title: Provider-neutral control-plane foundation
items.objective: Provide durable task contracts and isolated provider execution primitives needed for resilient automation.
items.user_problem: Long-running provider work cannot be safely resumed, observed or recovered from a task ledger.
acceptance_criteria: Exact-head CI passes
State transitions and cancellation/retry bounds have deterministic tests
No laptop Runner dependency or paid resource is introduced
stop_conditions: No deployment or always-on host provisioning

items.title: Durable provider dispatch outbox
items.objective: Make dispatch durable across restart and reconcile queued work.
items.user_problem: A dispatched background task could be lost or left ambiguous after process restart.
acceptance_criteria: PR #74 integration prerequisite is satisfied
Exactly-once-or-idempotent dispatch behavior is covered by restart tests
Recovery is bounded and observable
stop_conditions: Do not merge stacked branch out of dependency order
Do not turn the owner's laptop into an assumed always-on worker

items.title: Provider-neutral parallel workstream decomposition
items.objective: Split the provider-neutral architecture into non-overlapping, independently testable tasks.
items.user_problem: Infrastructure work is difficult to parallelize without conflicting changes.
acceptance_criteria: Dependency graph has no cycles
Each workstream has owner, bounded scope, acceptance and stop rules
stop_conditions: Do not duplicate the main work register
Do not stack dependent PRs as parallel merge candidates

items.title: User authentication and API authorization
items.objective: Implement safe sign-in, route guarding and backend API authorization with fail-closed configuration.
items.user_problem: The current user app has no wired authentication path, so user research data is not safely isolated.
acceptance_criteria: Missing secrets/configuration fail closed
No credentials/secrets committed
Unauthenticated private API requests are rejected
Browser E2E verifies sign-in, protected navigation and logout
stop_conditions: No admin privilege implied by user login
Do not expose deployment until owner-provided secrets are configured securely

items.title: Read-only admin operations workspace
items.objective: Replace starter admin surfaces with a truthful, read-only operations workspace.
items.user_problem: There is no usable operator view of service health, provider readiness or recent system events.
deliverables: Explicit auth/role boundary and audit event model
acceptance_criteria: No placeholder/demo health data
No unauthenticated admin endpoints
Browser/API smoke covers health and source status
Admin remains out of public deployment until security gates pass
stop_conditions: No destructive admin actions in first slice
No exposure through public Compose before authentication and authorization pass

items.title: End-to-end market research dossier
items.objective: Deliver one end-to-end market selection to evidence dossier journey using only data that passed its own source gate.
items.user_problem: The user cannot currently complete a grounded six-month research workflow inside the application.
deliverables: Unavailable-analysis explanation and saved dossier history
acceptance_criteria: One browser journey passes from login through dossier view
Every displayed observation links to source/time/units
No unsupported recommendation or confidence claim
User-facing acceptance scenario is reproducible
stop_conditions: If no eligible data exists, show an honest unavailable state rather than substituting a candidate provider
Do not enable scoring or allocation
